entity.name: Serhii Stotskyi
entity.description: Creator and maintainer of CASL, an MIT-licensed TypeScript authorization library.

projects.name: CASL
projects.description: An isomorphic authorization library for JavaScript and TypeScript that makes it easy to manage and share permissions across UI components, API services, and database queries. Includes integrations for React, Vue, Angular, Mongoose, and Prisma.
